jobs.title: Recruiter (GTM)
jobs.description: We are Workerbase - a fast-growing software company on a mission to digitize and supercharge manual working processes in manufacturing. Trusted by Fortune 500 companies like Porsche, Siemens, and Gazelle Bikes, we're building the platform that connects human workers and machines in one seamless digital ecosystem. We're now a team of 40, and this is exactly where things get exciting. To hit our next growth milestone, we need a sharp, energetic Recruiter with a Go-to-Market focus: someone who knows how to find and win top sales talent in a fast-moving environment, and who helps us build the team that will change manufacturing forever. jobs.title: Director of People Operations
jobs.description: About Us Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar. Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes. 2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler. We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law. Joining Legora means three things. We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions. We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback. We grow together: as a team and with our customers. Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts. If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place. The role This role owns how it works to be an employee at Legora on the backend. You will operationalise every stage of the employee journey, making sure every moment is supported by clean systems, accurate data, and processes that scale. If an employee interacts with a Legora program or system, from their first day in the HRIS to a salary change three years in, your team is accountable for making it accurate, timely, and smooth. You will lead a distributed People Operations team across Stockholm and New York, reporting to the VP, People Operations. Mit ihren regionalen Qualitätsmedien – der Augsburger Allgemeinen inklusive Allgäuer Zeitung, der Main-Post in Würzburg sowie dem SÜDKURIER in Konstanz – erreicht sie bei einer täglichen Druckauflage von rund 450.000 Exemplaren etwa 1,3 Millionen Leser. Unser Bereich Shared Services bündelt standortübergreifend zentrale Servicefunktionen innerhalb der Gruppe. Dazu gehören die Bereiche IT, Finance & Controlling, HR, Procurement & Sustainability (einschließlich Facility Management und Mobility) sowie Legal & Compliance. Zur Unterstützung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Termin einen engagierten und zuverlässigen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) für den Bereich Vertragsmanagement und HR-Schriftverkehr am Standort Würzburg Deine Aufgaben: Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung, Bearbeitung und Verwaltung von Verträgen sowie weiteren Personaldokumenten. Du wirkst bei der Erstellung und Bearbeitung des gesamten HR-Schriftverkehrs mit und behältst dabei Fristen und Termine im Blick. Du unterstützt das HR-Team bei allgemeinen administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben. Du sorgst für eine sorgfältige und vertrauliche Bearbeitung personenbezogener Daten. Dein Profil: Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d), idealerweise in einem kaufmännischen, wirtschafts-, rechts- oder personalbezogenen Studiengang. jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Intern
jobs.description: Our Team We believe travel can create citizens of the world. We spark moments of connection and transformation, giving people the freedom to explore openly and shape their own story. With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity fuels curiosity, insight, and a culture of openness, essential to understanding our travellers and one another. We work in a flexible hybrid model from our Utrecht HQ and our homes across the Netherlands. Just as travel is about discovery, we’re looking for people who want to go one stop further, joining a journey that inspires personal transformation through train travel. We’re looking for: You’re someone with a real interest in people and an energetic team player with drive and a genuine eagerness to learn, especially when it comes to finding and welcoming new talent. You’ll join our People & Culture team and work closely with Talent Acquisition on real recruitment projects, so you gain practical experience from day one. Our P&C team Our P&C team drives engagement and performance. We focus on all elements of People and Culture, including Learning and Development, Recruitment, Employee Relations, Office Management and Employee Experience. Within the team, Talent Acquisition looks after everything from the first job post to a new colleague’s first day, and that’s where you’ll spend most of your time. What you will be doing: Working closely with Talent Acquisition, you’ll gain hands-on experience in: Replying to candidates’ general questions by email, making sure everyone who gets in touch receives a kind, clear and timely answer. Scheduling interviews in close collaboration with our hiring managers, so the process runs smoothly for candidates and interviewers alike. Joining interviews alongside Talent Acquisition, so you can learn how great interviews work and build your own interviewing skills along the way. jobs.description: We welcome applicants based anywhere in Europe. About Reedsy We’re here to give authors the tools and resources they need to create beautiful books. Our marketplace gathers the industry's best publishing professionals — the likes of Neil Gaiman's editor, Nora Roberts' book marketer, and GRRM’s cover designer. We’ve grown to a community of 5,000,000 authors, and transformed the way people write and publish their book. Want to hop on board and help us get to our next destination? Cool, keep reading! Job Description Your role is to assist the Reedsy Talent team in hiring a few high-impact employees each year. We’ll look not only for the most talented but also the ones who understand the purpose of Reedsy. We take our time and carefully select every new Reedsian — "hire fast, fire fast" is not our model. Review applications for open roles and fast-track top ones; Seek out passive talent; Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers; Identify alternative strategies to attract new talent; and Work with our Talent team to create and develop a great candidate experience. Requirements Strong interest in talent acquisition, recruitment, and human resources practices; Analytical mind; Eye for detail to find the perfect match for the team; Autonomous way of working and motivation to familiarise yourself with new topics; Strong writing skills and native-level English speaker. Availability to work full-time for 6 months Bonus Points Previous experience in screening candidates; Understanding of marketing and technical profiles; Experience with tech platforms available for recruiting; A good dose of ambition, a willingness to learn, and a great sense of humor. Benefits Work from home Salary range £14k – £26k

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Operations & Supply Chain (m(w/d)
jobs.description: Unser Kunde ist ein etabliertes Unternehmen im Bereich Fracht- und Lagerlösungen und optimiert Prozesse rund um Warentransport und -verteilung. Als Operations Recruiter gestalten Sie aktiv mit, wie ein Unternehmen wächst – denn ohne die richtigen Menschen an Bord bleibt jede Wachstumsstrategie nur Theorie. Sie sind die Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen und Talenten, verstehen die operativen Herausforderungen im Detail und finden genau die Persönlichkeiten, die diesen Bereich voranbringen. Kein Recruiting von der Stange, sondern echtes Verständnis für Prozesse, Teams und Menschen. Wenn Sie gern eigenverantwortlich arbeiten, ein Gespür für Menschen haben und dabei sein wollen, wenn Teams entstehen, die den Unterschied machen – dann ist diese Rolle genau richtig für Sie. Aufgaben Mit klarem Fokus auf gewerbliche Mitarbeitende übernehmen Sie die Steuerung und Verantwortung für den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess bis zur erfolgreichen Besetzung. In enger Kooperation mit der Agentur für Arbeit planen und leiten Sie Bewerbertage sowie Auswahlverfahren vor Ort. Sie sprechen potenzielle Kandidaten proaktiv über verschiedene Kanäle an und pflegen die Bewerberdatenbank. Zur effizienten Vorqualifizierung und Auswahl geeigneter Bewerber – sowohl gewerblich als auch kaufmännisch – organisieren und führen Sie strukturierte Interviews. Mit internen Stakeholdern, Personaldienstleistern sowie dem Employer-Branding-Team stehen Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit. Um einen reibungslosen und skalierbaren Projektaufbau sicherzustellen, analysieren Sie Recruiting-Kennzahlen und optimieren die Prozesse fortlaufend. Qualifikation Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre (BWL), der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, der Wirtschaftspsychologie oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung bringen Sie mit. Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Recruiting. Idealerweise bringen Sie zudem Kenntnisse des regionalen Arbeitsmarkts in der Supply Chain mit. Kommunikationsstärke und Organisationst

We are a collective of proven professionals who have run their own desks, managed client relationships end-to-end, and understand what it takes to generate revenue. We are not a traditional agency—and we are not a place to “learn recruiting.” This is a peer-level environment for recruiters who value ownership, flexibility, and independence, while recognizing that collaboration can accelerate growth. This model is designed for recruiters who are already successful but want to scale smarter , reduce overhead, and avoid working in isolation.
